1	# Contract: `ExportRepository` / `ExportFileRepository`
2	
3	`lib/features/export/domain/repositories/export_repository.dart`,
4	`lib/features/export/domain/repositories/export_file_repository.dart`, implemented by
5	`lib/features/export/data/export_repository_impl.dart`/`export_file_repository_impl.dart`.
6	
7	```dart
8	abstract class ExportRepository {
9	  Future<Either<Failure, String>> create({required DateTime? periodStart, required DateTime? periodEnd});
10	  Future<Either<Failure, ExportJob>> status(String jobId);
11	  Future<Either<Failure, Uint8List>> download({required String jobId, required ExportFormat format});
12	}
13	
14	abstract class ExportFileRepository {
15	  Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> share({required Uint8List bytes, required ExportFormat format});
16	}
17	```
18	
19	## `ExportRepositoryImpl.create` — request shape
20	
21	```dart
22	await _apiClient.call(
23	  'export-summary-create',
24	  method: 'POST',
25	  body: {
26	    'periodStart': periodStart?.toUtc().toIso8601String(),  // explicit null, never omitted — both keys are
27	    'periodEnd': periodEnd?.toUtc().toIso8601String(),      // in the OpenAPI schema's `required` list even
28	    'includeNarrative': true,                               // though both are `nullable: true`
29	  },
30	);
31	```
32	
33	Parses `data.jobId` (string) from the `202` response; `data.status` is always `'pending'` at this point and is
34	not separately parsed (the first `status()` poll re-derives the real `ExportJob` immediately after).
35	`EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` (400) is mapped by the existing, shared `ErrorMapper.fromResponse` → `Left
36	(ExportEmptyPeriodFailure)` — no export-specific error parsing needed.
37	
38	## `ExportRepositoryImpl.status` — response shape
39	
40	```dart
41	await _apiClient.call('export-status-get', method: 'GET', pathSegments: [jobId]);
42	```
43	
44	Parses the full `ExportJob` (`data.jobId`/`data.status`/`data.narrativeStatus`/`data.entryCount`/
45	`data.errorCode`/`data.narrativeErrorCode`/`data.downloadAvailable`) — every field in the OpenAPI schema's own
46	`required` list, all nullable except `jobId`/`status`/`narrativeStatus`/`downloadAvailable`. `status`'s wire
47	value `data_ready` parses to `ExportJobStatus.dataReady` via an explicit lookup table (not `.byName`, since
48	Dart enum names cannot contain an underscore the way the wire value does) — every other enum
49	(`ExportJobStatus`'s other four values, all of `NarrativeStatus`) parses via `.byName` as usual.
50	
51	## `ExportRepositoryImpl.download` — delegates to `ApiClient.downloadFile`
52	
53	```dart
54	await _apiClient.downloadFile(
55	  'export-download-get',
56	  pathSegments: [jobId],
57	  queryParameters: {'format': format.name},  // 'pdf' | 'raw'
58	);
59	```
60	
61	No response parsing — `contracts/http-client-download-extension.md` already returns raw `Uint8List`.
62	
63	## Silent-refresh-and-retry — identical shape across all three methods
64	
65	```dart
66	Future<Either<Failure, T>> _retryAfterSilentRefresh<T>(Future<Either<Failure, T>> Function() retry) async {
67	  final refreshed = await _sessionRepository.refresh();
68	  return refreshed.match(
69	    (_) => Future.value(const Left(AuthExpiredFailure(message: 'Session could not be renewed', requestId: ''))),
70	    (_) => retry(),
71	  );
72	}
73	```
74	
75	Copied verbatim from `EntriesRepositoryImpl` (RF07) — exactly one retry; a second `AuthExpiredFailure` after
76	that retry is returned as-is, never a loop.
77	
78	## `ExportFileRepositoryImpl.share` — behavior
79	
80	```dart
81	Future<Either<Failure, Unit>> share({required Uint8List bytes, required ExportFormat format}) async {
82	  try {
83	    final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
84	    final extension = format == ExportFormat.pdf ? 'pdf' : 'json';
85	    final name = format == ExportFormat.pdf ? 'cerne-resumo' : 'cerne-dados';
86	    final file = File('${dir.path}/$name.$extension');
87	    await file.writeAsBytes(bytes, flush: true);
88	    await Share.shareXFiles([XFile(file.path)]);
89	    return const Right(unit);
90	  } catch (_) {
91	    return const Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure(message: 'Falha ao salvar/compartilhar o arquivo.', requestId: ''));
92	  }
93	}

95	
96	A `share_plus` cancel (the user dismissing the OS share sheet without picking a target) is reported by the
97	package as a normal, non-throwing `ShareResult` — never reaches the `catch` above, and is treated as success
98	(`Right(unit)`): the file *was* produced and offered; whether the user then chose to save it is outside this

103	| # | Scenario | Expected |
104	|---|---|---|
105	| 1 | `create()` — backend returns `202 {jobId: 'abc'}` | `Right('abc')` |
106	| 2 | `create()` — backend returns `400 {code: 'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD', ...}` | `Left(ExportEmptyPeriodFailure)` |

110	| 6 | `status()` — backend returns `{status: 'data_ready', narrativeStatus: 'processing', downloadAvailable: true, ...}` | `Right(ExportJob(status: dataReady, narrativeStatus: processing, ...))` |
111	| 7 | `status()` — malformed body (missing a required field) | `Left(ValidationFailure)` |
112	| 8 | `create()`/`status()`/`download()` — first attempt `AuthExpiredFailure`, `SessionRepository.refresh()` succeeds, retried call succeeds | the retried call's own `Right(...)` |
113	| 9 | Same as 8, but `refresh()` itself fails | `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)` — exactly one retry, no loop |

1	# Contract: `ApiClient.downloadFile` (`lib/core/network/api_client.dart`)
2	
3	Extends `ApiClient` (F000/RF01, already extended by RF04's `sseStream()`) in place. `call()`/`sseStream()` are
4	unchanged. This is a `core/network/` addition, not export-specific — any future signed-URL-download unit
5	reuses it as-is (research.md R1).
6	
7	```dart
8	Future<Either<Failure, Uint8List>> downloadFile(
9	  String function, {
10	  List<String>? pathSegments,
11	  Map<String, dynamic>? queryParameters,
12	  AuthMode authMode = AuthMode.userSession,
13	}) async {
14	  final baseUrl = dotenv.env['FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL'] ?? '';
15	  final segments = [function, ...?pathSegments];
16	  final url = '$baseUrl/${segments.join('/')}';
17	  final bearer = authMode == AuthMode.anonKey
18	      ? _anonKey
19	      : (await _tokenStorage.readAccessToken() ?? '');
20	
21	  try {
22	    // Leg 1 — our own backend function. Same apikey/Authorization headers every other `call()` already
23	    // sends. `followRedirects: false` + accepting <400 via `validateStatus` means a 302 lands here as a
24	    // normal response object instead of being auto-followed (which would forward these headers to Storage).
25	    final redirectResponse = await _dio.request<void>(
26	      url,
27	      queryParameters: queryParameters,
28	      options: Options(
29	        method: 'GET',
30	        headers: {'apikey': _anonKey, 'Authorization': 'Bearer $bearer'},
31	        followRedirects: false,
32	        validateStatus: (status) => status != null && status < 400,
33	      ),
34	    );
35	
36	    final location = redirectResponse.headers.value('location');
37	    if (redirectResponse.statusCode != 302 || location == null) {
38	      return const Left(
39	        ValidationFailure(message: 'Malformed response: expected a 302 redirect', requestId: ''),
40	      );
41	    }
42	
43	    // Leg 2 — the signed Storage URL. Deliberately NO apikey/Authorization headers: the signed URL already
44	    // carries its own short-lived auth via query parameters, and forwarding this app's own credentials to a
45	    // third-party host they were never scoped for is an unnecessary exposure (research.md R1).
46	    final fileResponse = await _dio.request<List<int>>(
47	      location,
48	      options: Options(method: 'GET', responseType: ResponseType.bytes),
49	    );
50	
51	    return Right(Uint8List.fromList(fileResponse.data ?? const []));
52	  } on DioException catch (e) {
53	    // Leg 1 failures (our backend's own {code, message, retryable} envelope) map through the exact same
54	    // `_mapException` every other call() site already uses. Leg 2 failures (the storage host never speaks
55	    // this app's error envelope — a 403/404 from an expired signed URL, a dropped connection mid-download)
56	    // have no `{code, message, retryable}` body to parse, so they fall through `_mapException`'s own
57	    // no-JSON-body branch and resolve to the same retryable `NetworkOfflineFailure`/`NetworkTimeoutFailure`
58	    // it already synthesizes for a connection-level failure — never a new, undocumented Failure subtype.
59	    return Left(_mapException(e));
60	  }
61	}
62	```
63	
64	- Exactly two network round-trips per call, in sequence — never more (no following of a second redirect; a
65	  Storage response that itself redirects again is treated as leg 2's own non-2xx failure via `_mapException`,
66	  since `_dio.request<List<int>>` here keeps `dio`'s default `followRedirects: true` only for leg 2, where no
67	  credential is being forwarded in the first place, so a further redirect being auto-followed is harmless).
68	- No `unwrapData`-style parameter and no `body` parameter — `GET /export/{jobId}/download` takes no request
69	  body, and the return shape is always raw bytes, never a `{"data": ...}` JSON envelope.
70	
71	## Test scenarios this contract owns
72	
73	| # | Scenario | Expected |
74	|---|---|---|
75	| 1 | Leg 1 returns `302` with a valid `location` header; leg 2 returns `200` with bytes | `Right(Uint8List)` containing exactly those bytes |
76	| 2 | Leg 1 returns `200` (no redirect at all — a contract-violating response) | `Left(ValidationFailure)` |
77	| 3 | Leg 1 returns `302` with no `location` header | `Left(ValidationFailure)` |
78	| 4 | Leg 1 throws a `DioException` with `{code: 'AUTH_EXPIRED', ...}` in its response body | `Left(AuthExpiredFailure)` — identical mapping to `call()`'s own `AUTH_EXPIRED` handling |
79	| 5 | Leg 1 succeeds (302 + location); leg 2 throws a `DioException` with `type: connectionTimeout` | `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure)` — the storage-leg failure, not confused with a leg-1 failure |
80	| 6 | Leg 1 succeeds; leg 2 throws a `DioException` with no `response` at all (expired/garbage signed URL rejected at the transport level) | `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)` |
81	| 7 | `downloadFile` called with `queryParameters: {'format': 'raw'}` | leg 1's request URL carries `?format=raw` verbatim |
82

1	# Contract: Records header's download icon (`lib/features/records/presentation/pages/records_page.dart`)
2	
3	Extends `_Header`/`_RecordsPageState` in place (FR-001/FR-002/FR-011). `RecordsBloc`/`RecordsEvent`/
4	`RecordsState` are unchanged — no new event, no new field (research.md R8).
5	
6	```dart
7	class _Header extends StatelessWidget {
8	  const _Header({required this.onExportPressed});
9	  final VoidCallback onExportPressed;
10	
11	  @override
12	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
13	    return Padding(
14	      // ...unchanged back-arrow + title...
15	      child: Row(
16	        children: [
17	          /* back arrow, title — unchanged */
18	          IconButton(
19	            onPressed: onExportPressed,                              // was: () {} (inert placeholder)
20	            icon: const Icon(Icons.download_outlined, color: DesignTokens.colorTextPrimary),
21	          ),
22	        ],
23	      ),
24	    );
25	  }
26	}
27	```
28	
29	```dart
30	class _RecordsPageState extends State<RecordsPage> {
31	  bool _isOpeningExportSheet = false;   // NEW
32	
33	  Future<void> _openExportSheet(BuildContext context) async {
34	    if (_isOpeningExportSheet) return;                                   // FR-011
35	    _isOpeningExportSheet = true;
36	    final state = context.read<RecordsBloc>().state;
37	    final dateRange = state is RecordsLoaded ? state.dateRange : DateRangeOption.allTime;
38	    final bounds = dateRange.boundsAt(DateTime.now());                    // RF06's own pure extension, reused
39	    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
40	      context: context,
41	      isScrollControlled: true,
42	      builder: (_) => ExportSheet(periodStart: bounds.from, periodEnd: bounds.to),
43	    );
44	    if (mounted) _isOpeningExportSheet = false;
45	  }
46	
47	  // build(): `_Header(onExportPressed: () => _openExportSheet(context))` replaces the bare `_Header()`.
48	}
49	```
50	
51	- `_isOpeningExportSheet` resets to `false` only after `showModalBottomSheet`'s `Future` resolves (the sheet
52	  was dismissed) and only if the widget is still mounted — a second tap while the sheet is open is already
53	  physically blocked by the modal barrier Flutter itself draws, so this flag's only real job is absorbing a
54	  double-tap in the brief window before the sheet has finished animating in.
55	- No change to `RecordsBloc`'s own filter state: reading `context.read<RecordsBloc>().state` here is a
56	  one-time snapshot at tap time, never a `watch` — `_Header` itself stays a plain, non-rebuilding
57	  `StatelessWidget` with respect to `RecordsBloc` (unaffected by RF05, same as `_SearchBar`'s existing
58	  `context.watch<RecordsBloc>()` usage for the filter icon's own highlight state, which this unit does not
59	  touch).

62	
63	| # | Scenario | Expected |
64	|---|---|---|
65	| 1 | `RecordsLoaded(dateRange: DateRangeOption.thisWeek)`, download icon tapped | `ExportSheet` is constructed with `periodStart` = this week's most-recent-Monday boundary, `periodEnd: null` |
66	| 2 | `RecordsLoaded(dateRange: DateRangeOption.allTime)`, download icon tapped | `ExportSheet` is constructed with `periodStart: null, periodEnd: null` |
67	| 3 | Download icon tapped twice in rapid succession (before the first `showModalBottomSheet` future resolves) | `showModalBottomSheet` is called exactly once |
68	| 4 | Sheet dismissed, download icon tapped again | `showModalBottomSheet` is called again (a fresh `ExportSheet`/`ExportBloc`, research.md R6) — not blocked by the now-`false` guard |
69	| 5 | Opening/closing the export sheet, at any of its states | `RecordsBloc`'s own state (`entries`, `dateRange`, scroll position via `ScrollController`) is bit-for-bit unchanged before and after (FR-010/SC-004) |

13	/// The interface that implementations of `share_plus` must implement.
14	class SharePlatform extends PlatformInterface {
15	  /// Constructs a SharePlatform.
16	  SharePlatform() : super(token: _token);
17	
18	  static final Object _token = Object();
19	
20	  static SharePlatform _instance = MethodChannelShare();
21	
22	  /// The default instance of [SharePlatform] to use.
23	  ///
24	  /// Defaults to [MethodChannelShare].
25	  static SharePlatform get instance => _instance;
26	
27	  /// Platform-specific plugins should set this with their own platform-specific
28	  /// class that extends [SharePlatform] when they register themselves.
29	  static set instance(SharePlatform instance) {
30	    PlatformInterface.verifyToken(instance, _token);
31	    _instance = instance;
32	  }
33	
34	  Future<ShareResult> share(ShareParams params) async {
35	    return _instance.share(params);
36	  }
37	}
38	
39	class ShareParams {
40	  /// The text to share
41	  ///
42	  /// Cannot be provided at the same time as [uri],
43	  /// as the share method will use one or the other.
44	  ///
45	  /// Can be used together with [files],
46	  /// but it depends on the receiving app if they support
47	  /// loading files and text from a share action.
48	  /// Some apps only support one or the other.
49	  ///
50	  /// * Supported platforms: All
51	  final String? text;
52	
53	  /// Used as share sheet title where supported
54	  ///
55	  /// Provided to Android Intent.createChooser as the title,
56	  /// as well as, EXTRA_TITLE Intent extra.
57	  ///
58	  /// Provided to web Navigator Share API as title.
59	  ///
60	  /// * Supported platforms: All
61	  final String? title;
62	
63	  /// Used as email subject where supported (e.g. EXTRA_SUBJECT on Android)
64	  ///
65	  /// When using the email fallback, this will be the subject of the email.
66	  ///
67	  /// * Supported platforms: All
68	  final String? subject;
69	
70	  /// Preview thumbnail
71	  ///
72	  /// TODO: https://github.com/fluttercommunity/plus_plugins/pull/3372
73	  ///
74	  /// * Supported platforms: Android
75	  ///   Parameter ignored on other platforms.
76	  final XFile? previewThumbnail;
77	
78	  /// The optional [sharePositionOrigin] parameter can be used to specify a global
79	  /// origin rect to anchor the share sheet to a widget user interacts with on iPads and Macs.
80	  /// It has no effect on other devices.
81	  ///
82	  /// If this parameter not provided on iPads the popover anchors to the center of the screen
83	  /// instead of throwing. Providing an accurate rect is still recommended for better UX.
84	  ///
85	  /// * Supported platforms: iPad and Mac
86	  ///   Parameter ignored on other platforms.
87	  final Rect? sharePositionOrigin;
88	
89	  /// Share a URI.
90	  ///
91	  /// On iOS, it will trigger the iOS system to fetch the html page
92	  /// (if available), and the website icon will be extracted and displayed on
93	  /// the iOS share sheet.
94	  ///
95	  /// On other platforms it behaves like sharing text.
96	  ///
97	  /// Cannot be used in combination with [text].
98	  ///
99	  /// * Supported platforms: iOS, Android
100	  ///   Falls back to sharing the URI as text on other platforms.
101	  final Uri? uri;
102	
103	  /// Share multiple files, can be used in combination with [text]
104	  ///
105	  /// Android supports all natively available MIME types (wildcards like image/*
106	  /// are also supported) and it's considered best practice to avoid mixing
107	  /// unrelated file types (eg. image/jpg & application/pdf). If MIME types are
108	  /// mixed the plugin attempts to find the lowest common denominator. Even
109	  /// if MIME types are supplied the receiving app decides if those are used
110	  /// or handled.
111	  ///
112	  /// On iOS image/jpg, image/jpeg and image/png are handled as images, while
113	  /// every other MIME type is considered a normal file.
114	  ///
115	  ///
116	  /// * Supported platforms: Android, iOS, Web, recent macOS and Windows versions
117	  ///   Throws an [UnimplementedError] on other platforms.
118	  final List<XFile>? files;
119	
120	  /// Override the names of shared files.
121	  ///
122	  /// When set, the list length must match the number of [files] to share.
123	  /// This is useful when sharing files that were created by [`XFile.fromData`](https://github.com/flutter/packages/blob/754de1918a339270b70971b6841cf1e04dd71050/packages/cross_file/lib/src/types/io.dart#L43),
124	  /// because name property will be ignored by  [`cross_file`](https://pub.dev/packages/cross_file) on all platforms except on web.
125	  ///
126	  /// * Supported platforms: Same as [files]
127	  ///   Ignored on platforms that don't support [files].
128	  final List<String>? fileNameOverrides;
129	
130	  /// Whether to fall back to downloading files if [share] fails on web.
131	  ///
132	  /// * Supported platforms: Web
133	  ///   Parameter ignored on other platforms.
134	  final bool downloadFallbackEnabled;
135	
136	  /// Whether to fall back to sending an email if [share] fails on web.
137	  ///
138	  /// * Supported platforms: Web
139	  ///   Parameter ignored on other platforms.
140	  final bool mailToFallbackEnabled;
141	
142	  /// Exclude services on iOS and macOS that you think are not suitable for your content.
143	  ///
144	  /// * Supported platforms: iOS, macOS
145	  ///   Parameter ignored on other platforms.
146	  final List<CupertinoActivityType>? excludedCupertinoActivities;
147	
148	  ShareParams({
149	    this.text,
150	    this.subject,
151	    this.title,
152	    this.previewThumbnail,
153	    this.sharePositionOrigin,
154	    this.uri,
155	    this.files,
156	    this.fileNameOverrides,
157	    this.downloadFallbackEnabled = true,
158	    this.mailToFallbackEnabled = true,
159	    this.excludedCupertinoActivities,
160	  });
161	}
162	
163	/// The result of a share to determine what action the
164	/// user has taken.
165	///
166	/// [status] provides an easy way to determine how the
167	/// share-sheet was handled by the user, while [raw] provides
168	/// possible access to the action selected.
169	class ShareResult {
170	  /// The raw return value from the share.
171	  ///
172	  /// Note that an empty string means the share-sheet was
173	  /// dismissed without any action and the special value
174	  /// `dev.fluttercommunity.plus/share/unavailable` points
175	  /// to the current environment not supporting share results.
176	  final String raw;
177	
178	  /// The action the user has taken
179	  final ShareResultStatus status;
180	
181	  const ShareResult(this.raw, this.status);
182	
183	  static const unavailable = ShareResult(
184	    'dev.fluttercommunity.plus/share/unavailable',
185	    ShareResultStatus.unavailable,
186	  );
187	
188	  @override
189	  bool operator ==(Object other) {
190	    if (identical(this, other)) return true;
191	
192	    return other is ShareResult && other.raw == raw && other.status == status;
193	  }
194	
195	  @override
196	  int get hashCode => raw.hashCode ^ status.hashCode;
197	
198	  @override
199	  String toString() {
200	    return 'ShareResult(raw: $raw, status: $status)';
201	  }
202	}
203	
204	/// How the user handled the share-sheet
205	enum ShareResultStatus {
206	  /// The user has selected an action
207	  success,
208	
209	  /// The user dismissed the share-sheet
210	  dismissed,
211	
212	  /// The platform succeed to share content to user
213	  /// but the user action can not be determined
214	  unavailable,
215	}
216	
217	/// Represents iOS-supported share activity types, such as AirDrop, Messages,
218	/// Mail, and others.
219	///
220	/// This enum is used to identify specific activity types in the iOS share sheet,
221	/// especially when certain types should be excluded from the share options.
222	///
223	/// See also:
224	/// [UIActivity.ActivityType](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/uiactivity/activitytype)
225	enum CupertinoActivityType {
226	  postToFacebook,
227	  postToTwitter,
228	  postToWeibo,
229	  message,
230	  mail,
231	  print,
232	  copyToPasteboard,
233	  assignToContact,
234	  saveToCameraRoll,
235	  addToReadingList,
236	  postToFlickr,
237	  postToVimeo,
238	  postToTencentWeibo,
239	  airDrop,
240	  openInIBooks,
241	  markupAsPDF,
242	  sharePlay,
243	  collaborationInviteWithLink,
244	  collaborationCopyLink,
245	  addToHomeScreen;
246	
247	  String get value {
248	    return toString().split('.').last;
249	  }
250	}
